.github/workflows/rust-concurrency.yml.content:
name: Rust concurrency evidence

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_concurrency.py"
      - "test/verify_rust_concurrency_export.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-concurrency.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/**"
      - "test/verify_rust_concurrency.py"
      - "test/verify_rust_concurrency_export.py"
      - ".github/workflows/rust-concurrency.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: "1.97.1"
      SOURCE_REVISION: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the recorded course toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.97.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Verify owned work, bounded messages, invariants and joined lifecycles
        run: python3 test/verify_rust_concurrency.py --proof output/rust-concurrency/proof.json
      - name: Retain formatter suggestions after a failed validation
        if: failure()
        run: |
          for role in starter solution; do
            for path in src/lib.rs src/main.rs src/ledger.rs diagnostics/*.rs; do
              for source in RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/"$role"/$path; do
                relative="${source#RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/}"
                destination="output/rust-concurrency/formatting/$relative"
                mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination")"
                rustfmt --edition 2024 --emit stdout "$source" > "$destination"
              done
            done
          done
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        if: always()
        with:
          name: rust-concurrency-evidence
          path: output/rust-concurrency/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Verify the plain exported source context and checkout refusals
        run: python3 test/verify_rust_concurrency_export.py --proof output/rust-concurrency-exported/proof.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        if: always()
        with:
          name: rust-concurrency-exported-evidence
          path: output/rust-concurrency-exported/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn

RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/README.md.content:
# Owned work, bounded messages and joined threads

Process at most eight fictional jobs with IDs 0 through 7 and unsigned 16-bit
values. A valid run reports every supplied ID once and the sum of those values.
IDs need not be consecutive. The starter is a working sequential baseline.
The reference partitions owned jobs across exactly two workers and receives
results through a synchronous channel with capacity two. Both implement the
same public output contract; the starter does not yet demonstrate concurrency.

## Trace the pipeline

Read Job, Mode, RunError, Report, Lifecycle and validate in src/lib.rs first.
Job owns its small fields and moves into one worker partition; no job is shared
mutably. The receiving coordinator alone owns the result vector. It sorts by ID
before reporting, because arrival order is not a source-order guarantee.
At most eight items, two workers and two buffered results exist. The maximum
total is 8 × 65535 = 524280, which fits u32.

Validation checks the item limit, then each ID's range and uniqueness in input
order. Invalid input starts no workers. FailItem(id) causes that job's worker to
send a typed error and stop. The coordinator requests cooperative cancellation,
drains until disconnection and joins every started worker. Other work may have
already completed; its count is deliberately not specified on failure. There is
no partial success report. CancelBeforeStart is a deterministic cancellation
seam: both workers start, observe the flag, close their senders and are joined.
An absent failure ID behaves like a normal run.

The reference drops the coordinator's original sender before receiving. A
receiver sees disconnection only after all sender owners have dropped and all
buffered messages have been received. Waiting to join while a worker is blocked
on a full sync_channel can deadlock. The receiver is therefore drained, or
dropped on a deadline/spawn failure, before all owned handles are joined.
Builder::spawn returns a Result; a failed spawn requests cancellation and joins
the handles already obtained. A join error becomes WorkerPanicked. A fixed
worker error is tested; host thread-creation failure and arbitrary panics are
handled paths, not failures this case claims to reproduce deterministically.

AtomicBool is only a cooperative stop hint. Relaxed ordering does not publish
the result data; owned channel messages and join provide those boundaries.
Do not attach a separate data-publication claim to the flag. Cancel is not a
transaction rollback, nor a guarantee that no further work happens afterward.

## Time and termination evidence

The coordinator uses one total two-second receive deadline, not a new full
timeout per message. Workers contain only a finite partition loop and a
bounded send. Dropping the receiver releases a blocked send; each started
handle is joined. No sleep, I/O, plugin callback or unbounded producer is used.
Join has no timeout and scheduling is outside this program's control. Thus
this is a bounded-work design plus observed termination evidence, not a hard
two-second whole-process or arbitrary-callback termination guarantee. The native
verifier puts a separate 30-second process limit around the fixed probe corpus.
Retain its measured elapsed time. Never add a hanging worker to test a timeout.
The tests account for successful completion, error propagation, pre-cancellation,
sender closure and equal started/joined counts. They do not prove all schedules,
deadlock freedom for arbitrary edits, starvation freedom or production throughput.

## Build and predict

Use Rust 1.97.1, edition 2024, Cargo, rustfmt and Clippy. Both roles include a
lockfile and use no external crates. From one role directory:

```sh
cargo fmt --all --check
rustfmt --edition 2024 --check diagnostics/*.rs
cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --offline
cargo run --locked --offline -- --help
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case valid
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case empty
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case cap
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case fail
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case cancel
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case duplicate
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case invalid-id
cargo run --locked --offline -- --case over
cargo build --locked --offline
```

Help prints `usage: concurrency_lab --help | --case NAME` and a newline to stdout,
status 0. Missing, extra, unknown or non-UTF-8 arguments print that same line only
to stderr, status 64. Argument collection stops after three items. The eight
named cases are fixed; the command accepts no path, URL, code or arbitrary work.

Valid prints `count=2 total=24 ids=0|3`, empty prints
`count=0 total=0 ids=-`, and cap prints
`count=8 total=524280 ids=0|1|2|3|4|5|6|7`, each with one final newline,
empty stderr and status 0. Failure cases write only stderr and status 65:
`error=worker-failed id=3`, `error=cancelled`, `error=duplicate-id`,
`error=invalid-id`, `error=too-many-items`, respectively. No output occurs until
the library run has joined its workers and returned its result.

Run `cargo clean`, then repeat tests and build. Save the whole project, including
README.md, Cargo.lock, src, diagnostics and observations.md. Record streams,
status, lifecycle and compiler version separately. A successful process exit is
not a substitute for exactly-once item accounting or started/joined equality.

## Core, continuation, choice and challenge

CORE: replace the sequential run with two owned partitions, a capacity-two
result channel, typed error propagation and a coordinator. Preserve validation,
sorted IDs and totals. Draw ownership transfers and list every sender owner.
The supplied sparse case combines nonconsecutive IDs and zero values. Add a
separate successful regression and predict its count, total and ordered IDs.

WORKFLOW: continue the same project. Predict empty, cap, failure and pre-cancel
cases. Prove each started handle is joined on success and error; explain the
drain/drop-before-join order. Add a regression and retain a clean rebuild.
Describe what the receive deadline bounds and what join does not bound.

CHOICE: study src/ledger.rs. Its single Mutex guard protects values, count and
total together; snapshots acquire the same lock. Test duplicate and invalid-ID
no-ops. The split atomic-update test forces an observer between two individually
atomic writes, without sleeping or relying on a lucky race. Explain why even
SeqCst on both counters cannot make two writes one compound transaction. Add a
snapshot invariant check and discuss poisoning without recovering invalid state.

CHALLENGE: compile the four diagnostics separately using
`rustc --edition=2024 diagnostics/NAME.rs -o NAME`.
rc-not-send and cell-not-sync must be refused with E0277; arc-owned and
scoped-shared compile and print 7. Read Rc versus Arc ownership and Send versus
Sync requirements. Arc does not make an arbitrary inner T thread-safe. Preserve
the diagnostics and explain the compiler message, then propose one valid fix.
Do not run the rejected examples or silence the check with unsafe code.

No network, real workload, daemon, shared environment mutation, arbitrary worker
callback or unbounded stress belongs in this exercise. Rust's memory safety does
not select a business invariant, ordering policy or shutdown protocol for us.

References: [Rust Book concurrency](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch16-00-concurrency.html),
[bounded messages](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/sync/mpsc/fn.sync_channel.html),
[receive timeout](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/sync/mpsc/struct.Receiver.html#method.recv_timeout),
[joining](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/thread/struct.JoinHandle.html#method.join).

RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/ob.content:
# Reference design and predictions

## CORE
Two owned partitions send at most eight results through one capacity-two
channel. Only the coordinator accumulates; sorted unique IDs and u32 totals
preserve the public report. Valid predicts count=2, total=24, IDs 0|3.
The starter is sequential; replacing it is a substantive change.

## WORKFLOW
The coordinator drops its sender, drains messages or drops the receiver,
then consumes every started handle with join. Empty still starts and joins two
workers. CancelBeforeStart predicts zero received values, no report and both
handles joined. FailItem(3) predicts a typed error; the other partition may
already have finished, so no exact partial received count is promised.
Copy actual format, lint, test, clean-build, stream, status and lifecycle
evidence into an attempt; these predictions do not certify a learner's run.

## CHOICE
Ledger holds one Mutex guard across values, count and total updates and uses
the same guard for snapshots. A duplicate ID changes none of those fields.
Even SeqCst counters leave an observation point between count and total writes;
the deterministic seam demonstrates the logic error without a memory data race.
Poisoning is reported; the reference does not assume a poisoned state is valid.

## CHALLENGE
Rc is not Send; sharing a Cell reference requires Sync, which Cell lacks.
The compiler must refuse those diagnostics with E0277. Arc of an immutable
integer can move to a worker; a scoped shared integer reference outlives its
child and is Sync. Both accepted diagnostics predict stdout 7 and status 0.

## LIMITS
Cancellation is cooperative and does not undo completed work. The receive
deadline is not a timed join or OS scheduling guarantee. The native corpus is
fixed, not an exhaustive schedule proof. This project does not exercise host
spawn failure or arbitrary panics deterministically and accepts no worker I/O.

test/verify_rust_concurrency.py.content:
"""Compile both RSS8 roles and retain bounded native work/lifecycle evidence."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import tomllib

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACK = ROOT / "RUST-08-concurrency-evidence"
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--source-kind", choices=["checkout","exported-workspace"], default="checkout")
args = parser.parse_args()
args.proof = args.proof.resolve()
assert not args.proof.exists()
assert os.getuid() != 0 and os.uname().sysname == "Linux" and os.uname().machine == "x86_64"
OUT = args.proof.parent
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
commands = []


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def stop(signum, _frame):
    raise SystemExit(128 + signum)


signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)


def run(command, cwd, label, expected=0, env=None, timeout=120):
    entry = dict(parentTaskId="rust-concurrency-evidence", parentPid=os.getpid(),
                 command=[os.fsdecode(value) for value in command], cwd=str(cwd),
                 startTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(), timeoutSeconds=timeout)
    start = time.monotonic()
    child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                             stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    entry["pid"] = child.pid
    with (OUT / "processes.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry, event="start")) + "\n")
    stdout, stderr, cleanup = b"", b"", "owned process exited"
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except BaseException:
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
        cleanup = "owned process group terminated and reaped"
        raise
    finally:
        with (OUT / "processes.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry, event="end", endTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),
                                         exitCode=child.returncode, childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup)) + "\n")
        (OUT / (label + ".stdout.txt")).write_bytes(stdout)
        (OUT / (label + ".stderr.txt")).write_bytes(stderr)
    assert child.returncode == expected, (label, child.returncode, stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
    commands.append(dict(label=label, exitCode=child.returncode, elapsedSeconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                         timeoutSeconds=timeout, stdoutSha256=sha(stdout), stderrSha256=sha(stderr)))
    return stdout, stderr


def verify_committed_bytes(actual, source):
    # Compare raw bytes with the selected commit, independently of the index,
    # clean filters, timestamps, and assume-unchanged flags.
    listing=run(["git","ls-tree","-rz","--full-tree",actual,"--",*source],ROOT,"committed-source-objects")[0]
    entries={}
    for row in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not row:
            continue
        header,name=row.split(b"\t",1)
        mode,kind,identity=header.split()
        assert mode in [b"100644",b"100755"] and kind==b"blob"
        name=name.decode()
        assert name not in entries
        entries[name]=identity.decode()
    assert entries.keys()==source.keys(),"Committed source paths differ"
    for name,raw in source.items():
        identity=hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw).hexdigest()
        assert identity==entries[name],"Source bytes differ from committed revision: "+name
    return entries



claimed=os.environ["SOURCE_REVISION"]
assert len(claimed)==40 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in claimed)
expected_names=['.github/workflows/rust-concurrency.yml', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/README.md', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/Cargo.lock', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/Cargo.toml', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/diagnostics/arc-owned.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/diagnostics/cell-not-sync.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/diagnostics/rc-not-send.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/diagnostics/scoped-shared.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/observations.md', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/src/ledger.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/src/lib.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/solution/src/main.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/Cargo.lock', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/Cargo.toml', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/diagnostics/arc-owned.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/diagnostics/cell-not-sync.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/diagnostics/rc-not-send.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/diagnostics/scoped-shared.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/observations.md', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/src/ledger.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/src/lib.rs', 'RUST-08-concurrency-evidence/starter/src/main.rs', 'test/verify_rust_concurrency.py', 'test/verify_rust_concurrency_export.py']
actual_revision=None
if args.source_kind=="checkout":
    actual_revision=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],ROOT,"actual-source-revision")[0].decode().strip()
    assert actual_revision==claimed,"Checked-out revision differs from claimed source"
    source_names=run(["git","ls-files","--",PACK.name,".github/workflows/rust-concurrency.yml","test/verify_rust_concurrency.py","test/verify_rust_concurrency_export.py"],ROOT,"source-inventory")[0].decode().splitlines()
    assert source_names==expected_names
else:
    source_names=expected_names
for name in source_names:
    cursor=ROOT
    for part in Path(name).parts:
        cursor=cursor/part
        assert not cursor.is_symlink(),"Linked source entry: "+name
    assert cursor.is_file(),"Missing source entry: "+name
package_files={name.removeprefix(PACK.name+"/") for name in expected_names if name.startswith(PACK.name+"/")}
package_dirs={Path(".")}
for name in package_files:package_dirs.update(Path(name).parents)
for relative in package_dirs:
    offset=0 if str(relative)=="." else len(relative.parts)
    children={Path(name).parts[offset] for name in package_files if Path(name).is_relative_to(relative) and len(Path(name).parts)>offset}
    assert {path.name for path in (PACK/relative).iterdir()}==children
source={name:(ROOT/name).read_bytes() for name in source_names}
assert all(b"\r" not in raw for raw in source.values())
committed_objects=verify_committed_bytes(actual_revision,source) if args.source_kind=="checkout" else None
versions = {name: run(command, ROOT, name)[0].decode().strip() for name, command in [
    ("rustc", ["rustc", "--version", "--verbose"]), ("cargo", ["cargo", "--version"]),
    ("rustfmt", ["rustfmt", "--version"]), ("clippy", ["cargo", "clippy", "--version"])]}
assert versions["rustc"].startswith("rustc 1.97.1 ")
USAGE = b"usage: concurrency_lab --help | --case NAME\n"
cases = {
    "valid": (b"count=2 total=24 ids=0|3\n", b"", 0),
    "empty": (b"count=0 total=0 ids=-\n", b"", 0),
    "cap": (b"count=8 total=524280 ids=0|1|2|3|4|5|6|7\n", b"", 0),
    **{name: (b"", ("error="+error+"\n").encode(), 65) for name, error in [
        ("fail", "worker-failed id=3"), ("cancel", "cancelled"), ("duplicate", "duplicate-id"),
        ("invalid-id", "invalid-id"), ("over", "too-many-items")]},
}
usage = [[], ["--case"], ["--help", "extra"], ["--case", "valid", "extra"],
         ["--case", "valid", "extra", "more"], ["--unknown"], ["valid"], ["--case", "unknown"]]

# This independent consumer supplies fixed vectors, without calling the CLI's case factory.
probe = r'''use concurrency_lab::{Job, Mode, run};
fn main() {
    for count in 0..=8 {
        for value in [0_u16, 1, 65535] {
            for reverse in [false, true] {
                let mut jobs: Vec<_> = (0..count).map(|id| Job { id, value }).collect();
                if reverse { jobs.reverse(); }
                let result = run(jobs, Mode::Normal);
                let life = &result.lifecycle;
                let report = result.report.unwrap();
                println!("normal {count} {value} {reverse} {} {} {} {} {} {}", report.total,
                         report.ids.iter().map(usize::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("|"),
                         life.spawned, life.joined, life.received, life.channel_closed);
            }
        }
    }
    let result = run(vec![Job { id: 7, value: 0 }, Job { id: 2, value: 65535 }, Job { id: 4, value: 0 }], Mode::Normal);
    let life = &result.lifecycle;
    let report = result.report.unwrap();
    println!("sparse {} {} {} {} {} {}", report.total,
             report.ids.iter().map(usize::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("|"),
             life.spawned, life.joined, life.received, life.channel_closed);
    for id in 0..8 {
        let jobs = (0..8).map(|id| Job { id, value: 7 }).collect();
        let result = run(jobs, Mode::FailItem(id));
        assert_eq!(result.report, Err(concurrency_lab::RunError::WorkerFailed(id)));
        assert!(result.lifecycle.cancelled);
        println!("failed {id} {} {} {}", result.lifecycle.spawned, result.lifecycle.joined, result.lifecycle.channel_closed);
    }
    let result = run(vec![Job { id: 7, value: 7 }], Mode::CancelBeforeStart);
    assert_eq!(result.report, Err(concurrency_lab::RunError::Cancelled));
    assert!(result.lifecycle.cancelled);
    assert_eq!(result.lifecycle.received, 0);
    println!("cancelled {} {} {}", result.lifecycle.spawned, result.lifecycle.joined, result.lifecycle.channel_closed);
}
'''
roles = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rust-concurrency-") as temporary:
    work = Path(temporary)
    for role in ("starter", "solution"):
        selected = PACK / role
        project = work / role
        shutil.copytree(selected, project)
        original = {p.relative_to(selected): p.read_bytes() for p in selected.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
        lock = (project / "Cargo.lock").read_bytes()
        assert tomllib.loads((project/"Cargo.toml").read_text()) == {"package": {"name":"concurrency_lab", "version":"1.0.0", "edition":"2024"}}
        assert tomllib.loads(lock.decode())["package"] == [{"name":"concurrency_lab", "version":"1.0.0"}]
        env = {**os.environ, "CARGO_TARGET_DIR":str(work/(role+"-target")), "CARGO_NET_OFFLINE":"true"}
        run(["cargo", "fmt", "--all", "--check"], project, role+"-format", env=env)
        diagnostics = sorted((project/"diagnostics").glob("*.rs"))
        assert len(diagnostics) == 4
        run(["rustfmt", "--edition", "2024", "--check", *map(str, diagnostics)], project, role+"-diagnostic-format", env=env)
        run(["cargo", "clippy", "--locked", "--offline", "--all-targets", "--", "-D", "warnings"], project, role+"-clippy", env=env)
        assert b"17 passed; 0 failed" in run(["cargo", "test", "--locked", "--offline"],project,role+"-tests",env=env)[0]
        run(["cargo", "build", "--locked", "--offline"],project,role+"-build",env=env)
        binary = Path(env["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"])/"debug/concurrency_lab"
        assert run([str(binary), "--help"],work,role+"-help",env=env,timeout=30)==(USAGE,b"")
        for repeat in range(3):
            for name, expected in cases.items():
                assert run([str(binary),"--case",name],work,f"{role}-case-{name}-{repeat}",expected=expected[2],env=env,timeout=30)==expected[:2]
        for index, arguments in enumerate(usage):
            assert run([str(binary), *arguments],work,f"{role}-usage-{index}",expected=64,env=env,timeout=30)==(b"",USAGE)
        for index, arguments in enumerate([[b"--case", b"\xff"],[b"\xff"]]):
            assert run([os.fsencode(binary), *arguments],work,f"{role}-utf8-{index}",expected=64,env=env,timeout=30)==(b"",USAGE)
        for diagnostic in diagnostics:
            rejected = diagnostic.stem in {"rc-not-send", "cell-not-sync"}
            target = work / (role+"-"+diagnostic.stem)
            out, err = run(["rustc","--edition=2024","--error-format=json",str(diagnostic),"-o",str(target)],work,role+"-"+diagnostic.stem+"-compile",expected=int(rejected),env=env)
            assert out == b""
            if rejected:
                messages=[json.loads(line) for line in err.splitlines()]
                assert any(message.get("code",{}).get("code")=="E0277" for message in messages if isinstance(message.get("code"),dict))
                assert not target.exists()
            else:
                assert err == b""
                assert run([str(target)],work,role+"-"+diagnostic.stem+"-run",env=env,timeout=30)==(b"7\n",b"")
        harness = work / (role+"-consumer.rs")
        harness.write_text(probe)
        consumer = work / (role+"-consumer")
        run(["rustc", "--edition=2024", "--crate-name", "consumer", str(harness), "--extern",
             "concurrency_lab="+str(Path(env["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"])/"debug/libconcurrency_lab.rlib"),
             "-L", "dependency="+str(Path(env["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"])/"debug/deps"), "-o", str(consumer)],work,role+"-consumer-compile",env=env)
        output, err = run([str(consumer)],work,role+"-consumer-run",env=env,timeout=30)
        assert err == b""
        rows = output.decode().splitlines()
        assert len(rows) == 64
        for index, row in enumerate(rows[:54]):
            # Empty IDs form a blank field, preserved by split(" ").
            kind,count,value,reverse,total,ids,spawned,joined,received,closed = row.split(" ")

            assert received == count and spawned == joined == (2 if role=="solution" else 0)
            assert closed == str(role=="solution").lower()
        assert rows[54].split() == ["sparse", "65535", "2|4|7", "2" if role=="solution" else "0", "2" if role=="solution" else "0", "3", str(role=="solution").lower()]
        for index, row in enumerate(rows[55:63]):

            assert kind == "failed" and int(id_value) == index
            assert spawned == joined == ("2" if role=="solution" else "0")
            assert closed == str(role=="solution").lower()
        kind,spawned,joined,closed = rows[63].split()
        assert kind == "cancelled" and spawned == joined == ("2" if role=="solution" else "0")
        assert closed == str(role=="solution").lower()
        run(["cargo","clean"],project,role+"-clean",env=env)
        assert not binary.exists()
        assert b"17 passed; 0 failed" in run(["cargo","test","--locked","--offline"],project,role+"-clean-tests",env=env)[0]
        run(["cargo","build","--locked","--offline"],project,role+"-clean-build",env=env)
        assert run([str(binary),"--case","valid"],work,role+"-clean-valid",env=env,timeout=30)==cases["valid"][:2]
        assert {p.relative_to(project):p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}==original
        saved=OUT/role
        saved.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(binary,saved/"concurrency_lab")
        roles.append(dict(role=role,unitTests=17,unitTestsBeforeAndAfterClean=True,sourceAndLockUnchanged=True,
                          nativeContractCases=64,cliCases=24,usageRefusals=10,compilerRefusals=2,
                          executableSha256=sha(binary.read_bytes()),lifecycleProbeRows=rows,
                          observedProbeElapsedSeconds=next(c["elapsedSeconds"] for c in commands if c["label"]==role+"-consumer-run")))
assert not work.exists() and all((ROOT/name).read_bytes()==raw for name,raw in source.items())

           ordinaryUser=True,sourceFiles={n:sha(r) for n,r in source.items()},allSourceFilesUnchanged=True,

test/verify_rust_concurrency_export.py.content:
"""Compile both RSS8 roles and retain bounded native work/lifecycle evidence."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import tomllib

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACK = ROOT / "RUST-08-concurrency-evidence"
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
args.proof = args.proof.resolve()
assert not args.proof.exists()
assert os.getuid() != 0 and os.uname().sysname == "Linux" and os.uname().machine == "x86_64"
OUT = args.proof.parent
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
commands = []


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def stop(signum, _frame):
    raise SystemExit(128 + signum)


signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)


def run(command, cwd, label, expected=0, env=None, timeout=120):
    entry = dict(parentTaskId="rust-concurrency-exported-evidence", parentPid=os.getpid(),
                 command=[os.fsdecode(value) for value in command], cwd=str(cwd),
                 startTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(), timeoutSeconds=timeout)
    start = time.monotonic()
    child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                             stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    entry["pid"] = child.pid
    with (OUT / "processes.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry, event="start")) + "\n")
    stdout, stderr, cleanup = b"", b"", "owned process exited"
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except BaseException:
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
        cleanup = "owned process group terminated and reaped"
        raise
    finally:
        with (OUT / "processes.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(dict(entry, event="end", endTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),
                                         exitCode=child.returncode, childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup)) + "\n")
        (OUT / (label + ".stdout.txt")).write_bytes(stdout)
        (OUT / (label + ".stderr.txt")).write_bytes(stderr)
    assert child.returncode == expected, (label, child.returncode, stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
    commands.append(dict(label=label, exitCode=child.returncode, elapsedSeconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                         timeoutSeconds=timeout, stdoutSha256=sha(stdout), stderrSha256=sha(stderr)))
    return stdout, stderr


def verify_committed_bytes(actual, source):
    # Compare raw bytes with the selected commit, independently of the index,
    # clean filters, timestamps, and assume-unchanged flags.
    listing=run(["git","ls-tree","-rz","--full-tree",actual,"--",*source],ROOT,"committed-source-objects")[0]
    entries={}
    for row in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not row:
            continue
        header,name=row.split(b"\t",1)
        mode,kind,identity=header.split()
        assert mode in [b"100644",b"100755"] and kind==b"blob"
        name=name.decode()
        assert name not in entries
        entries[name]=identity.decode()
    assert entries.keys()==source.keys(),"Committed source paths differ"
    for name,raw in source.items():
        identity=hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw).hexdigest()
        assert identity==entries[name],"Source bytes differ from committed revision: "+name
    return entries




actual=run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],ROOT,'actual-source-revision')[0].decode().strip()
assert actual==os.environ['SOURCE_REVISION']
role_names=['Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'src/lib.rs', 'src/ledger.rs', 'src/main.rs', 'observations.md', 'diagnostics/rc-not-send.rs', 'diagnostics/arc-owned.rs', 'diagnostics/cell-not-sync.rs', 'diagnostics/scoped-shared.rs']
tool_names=['test/verify_rust_concurrency.py','test/verify_rust_concurrency_export.py','.github/workflows/rust-concurrency.yml']
expected_names=sorted([PACK.name+'/README.md']+[PACK.name+'/'+role+'/'+name for role in ['starter','solution'] for name in role_names]+tool_names)
names=run(['git','ls-files','--',PACK.name,*tool_names],ROOT,'source-inventory')[0].decode().splitlines()
assert names==expected_names and len(names)==24
for name in names:
    cursor=ROOT
    for part in Path(name).parts:
        cursor=cursor/part
        assert not cursor.is_symlink()
    assert cursor.is_file()
source={name:(ROOT/name).read_bytes() for name in names}
assert all(b'\r' not in raw for raw in source.values())
committed=verify_committed_bytes(actual,source)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rust-concurrency-git-free-') as directory:
    packet=Path(directory)/'source-packet';packet.mkdir()
    assert not (packet/'.git').exists() and not (packet.parent/'.git').exists()
    for name,raw in source.items():
        path=packet/name;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_bytes(raw)
    exported=OUT/'exported'
    _,err=run(['python3',str(packet/'test/verify_rust_concurrency.py'),'--source-kind','exported-workspace','--proof',str(exported/'proof.json')],packet,'verify-git-free-packet',timeout=300)
    assert not err
    result=json.loads((exported/'proof.json').read_text())
    assert result['sourceKind']=='exported-workspace' and result['sourceDiscovery']=='fixed-filesystem'
    assert result['sourceRevision'] is None and result['checkedOutRevision'] is None and result['committedSourceObjects'] is None
    assert result['baseSourceRevision']==actual and not result['repositoryCIProvenanceClaimed']
    assert result['sourceFiles']=={name:sha(raw) for name,raw in source.items()} and len(result['commands'])==108
    events=[json.loads(line) for line in (exported/'processes.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    assert all(event['command'][0]!='git' for event in events)
    refused=OUT/'checkout-refusal'
    _,err=run(['python3',str(packet/'test/verify_rust_concurrency.py'),'--source-kind','checkout','--proof',str(refused/'proof.json')],packet,'reject-fake-checkout',expected=1,timeout=30)
    assert b'not a git repository' in err and not (refused/'proof.json').exists()
    assert not (packet/'.git').exists()
    assert {p.relative_to(packet).as_posix():p.read_bytes() for p in packet.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}==source
dirty_refusals=[]
reading=PACK/'README.md';original=reading.read_bytes()
try:
    reading.write_bytes(original+b'\nChanged worktree regression fixture.\n')
    for kind,script in [('native','verify_rust_concurrency.py'),('export','verify_rust_concurrency_export.py')]:
        refused=OUT/('dirty-checkout-'+kind)
        _,err=run(['python3',str(ROOT/'test'/script),'--proof',str(refused/'proof.json')],ROOT,'reject-dirty-'+kind,expected=1,timeout=30)
        assert b'Source bytes differ from committed revision:' in err and not (refused/'proof.json').exists()
        events=[json.loads(line) for line in (refused/'processes.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
        assert len(events)==6 and all(event['command'][0]=='git' for event in events)
        dirty_refusals.append(kind)
finally:
    reading.write_bytes(original)
assert not packet.exists() and all((ROOT/name).read_bytes()==raw for name,raw in source.items())
assert len(commands)==7
proof=dict(sourceRevision=actual,checkedOutRevision=actual,sourceKind='checkout',ordinaryUser=True,
           committedSourceObjects=committed,dirtyCheckoutRefusals=dirty_refusals,
           sourceFiles={name:sha(raw) for name,raw in source.items()},allSourceFilesUnchanged=True,
           temporarySourceCleanup=True,gitFreePacketValidated=True,exportedNativeCommands=108,
           gitNotUsedInsideExportValidation=True,exportedSourceDiscovery='fixed-filesystem',
           exportedCheckoutRevision=None,exportedRepositoryCIProvenanceClaimed=False,
           checkoutModeWithoutGitRefused=True,allRoleNativeChecksRepeated=True,actualIDEIntegrationNotInferred=True,
           commands=commands)
args.proof.write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(accepted=True,gitFreePacketValidated=True,exportedNativeCommands=108,dirtyCheckoutRefusals=2,proof=str(args.proof))))
